## Description

Compare annual growth in total assets and favor firms with restrained growth versus aggressive expansion.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon equity selection; often combined with value and profitability filters.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short, systematic value and fundamental funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time annual balance sheets, total assets, reporting dates, returns and sector identifiers.

## Caveats

Effects vary over time and can overlap with other factor exposures.
